input.prompt: Create ONE 16:9 photorealistic-natural WHAT IT COST documentary photographic asset, not a collage, graphic-design slide or poster. Everything photographed in one real physical setting. Small supporting ORIGINAL EDITORIAL WORKING NOTES, not official/company documents and not purported historical evidence. Print only the explicitly requested non-numeric analytical labels and notes, black ink, restrained normal serif. No invented prose, pseudo-writing, letterheads, seals, signatures, bank forms, case numbers, quotes, dates or monetary values. Real official sources and exact critical figures will be separate unchanged source/Fusion layers, never redraw them. No giant EDITORIAL ANALYSIS title, no generic A4 worksheet filling the screen. NO colored outlines, red/yellow accents, rectangles, arrows, underlines, highlights, source/provenance banners, glowing lines, counters, mechanisms, 3D diagrams, gold/marble, fake issued tickets or identification. No humans, faces, identifiable third-party brands. No device UI. Exact numbers/dates and analytical connectors are deliberately absent and will be editable Fusion nodes. Natural photographic restraint, not theatrical film prop styling. SCENE GF029. Supporting original lines 'Activity represented', 'Income represented', 'Wealth represented'. Not an additive pyramid, 3D staircase, money flow or invented record. Actual physical paper layers on dark tabletop, each packet at a different depth. Native hierarchy/links will be separate.
